decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's line extends the firm's established offer into a new segment whose results are uncertain given no evidence after 2019, but a small natural-cosmetics maker usually keeps a multi-item line it has invested in unless it clearly falls short of aspirations, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.
The cleansing foam fills out the established Sandorini series at low cost and fits the core assortment closely, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
